primary_intent: Record, exactly once, a penicillin AllergyIntolerance for the correct patient (Rosa Delgado, DOB 1979-06-14) with the specified SNOMED code/system and statuses; if it already exists, report it instead of creating a duplicate. A reasonable user would be inflexible about the correct patient linkage, code/system, and statuses, and about not introducing duplicates.
reasoning: Nitpicks: (1) Screenshots do not show the AllergyIntolerance detail view with fields or a patient-filtered list; (2) The agent’s narrative about list staleness is unverified; (3) Process involved multiple JSON edits. These do not materially affect the final outcome if the saved resource is correct. Critical issues: None evident — there is no contradiction between screenshots and claims; the latest screenshot shows the exact AllergyIntolerance ID the agent reports, and the action history shows the resource was created with the correct patient reference (matching the Patient ID seen for Rosa) and the required code/system and statuses. Critical-Point decision: The task permits saving; the agent crossed the CP and saved the AllergyIntolerance with the specified fields — this triggers SUCCESS. Outcome analysis: The patient Rosa Delgado (DOB 1979-06-14) is visibly present (Screenshot 1). The agent created an AllergyIntolerance via JSON with patient reference Patient/e40ee8df-5953-4c42-8728-582130b185e7 (matching Rosa), code SNOMED CT 91936005 with system http://snomed.info/sct, criticality high, clinicalStatus active (proper system), and verificationStatus confirmed (proper system), then saved. The final list shows a single AllergyIntolerance entry with ID a5b9d975-58be-4b1f-b727-3de7ec9e59e9, matching the RESULT line. While the screenshots don’t show the field-level view or an explicit patient-filtered list, the action history strongly supports correct linkage and values, and the list shows only one AllergyIntolerance in the system, so no duplicate was introduced. Thus, the primary intent — one correct penicillin allergy recorded for the correct patient — is satisfied.

items.criterion: Create the AllergyIntolerance with exact required fields and values, then save
items.condition: Only applies if no penicillin AllergyIntolerance exists for the patient
items.description: Create and save a new AllergyIntolerance for the patient with ONLY the specified fields set by the agent: (a) patient reference to the correct Patient, (b) code = SNOMED CT system http://snomed.info/sct, code 91936005 (Allergy to penicillin), (c) criticality = high, (d) clinicalStatus = active using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical, (e) verificationStatus = confirmed using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification. Partial credit for minor coding/system URI mistakes or if additional non-required fields are added due to platform constraints but the agent documents the limitation. No credit if the agent fails to save the record despite the platform allowing it, or creates multiple duplicates.
